## Problem statement

What user problem does this solve? Who experiences it, and how often?

## Proposed solution

What would a great solution look like? Be specific.

## Alternatives considered

What else did you consider? Why is the proposal preferred?

## Impact on existing features

Anything backward-incompatible? Privacy implications? Performance trade-offs?

## Additional context

Mockups, screenshots, references.
